description: Meteor addon that hides QuillCoin books in 2b2t dungeon chests without ever showing the hider a code or a coordinate

mods.name: QuillCoin Hider
mods.description: The tool the QuillCoin account uses to hide coins: writes and signs a book with a random code, hashes the code, drops the book into the open chest, and never shows the code to the person holding the mouse.
